t: This is 196 Queen's Gate, a house in South Kensington. It was designed by Richard Norman Shaw, a British architect who worked from the 1870s to the 1900s. He's considered to be among the greatest of British architects, best known for his country houses and for commercial buildings, and his influence on architectural style was strongest in the 1880s and 1890s. So this is a townhouse by one of the leading architects of the Victorian period.
